title: Return Balance Relief by Finch Circle Tier — Decision Table
content:
**Rule.** When Finch Circle Loyalty Program points are taken back on a refunded return, the return balance relief is 0.90 when the points the returned unit earned (its purchase points, bonus event and card bonus entries) are more than the points balance (the sum of the membership's points history) and the membership is Finch Circle Gold, Platinum, Diamond or Icon, 0.95 when they are more than the points balance and the membership is Finch Circle Member or Silver, and 1 when they are not more than the points balance.

The points the returned unit earned are the points on its purchase points entry (with any missing-points credit entry), its bonus event points entries and its card bonus entries. The points balance is the sum of the membership's points history: points earned and credited count in; return deductions, conversions into Finch Notes and forfeitures count out. The tier is the one on the membership record.

| Points the returned unit earned, against the points balance | Tier on the membership record | Return balance relief |
|---|---|---|
| more | Finch Circle Gold, Finch Circle Platinum, Finch Circle Diamond, Finch Circle Icon | 0.90 |
| more | Finch Circle Member, Finch Circle Silver | 0.95 |
| equal or fewer | any | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- The unit earned 900 points in all; balance 400; Finch Circle Platinum: 0.90.
- The unit earned 900 points; balance 400; Finch Circle Silver: 0.95.
- The unit earned 400 points; balance exactly 400: not more, 1.
